candidate.name: Wnt-lowering (tankyrase-type) agents and GSK3 modulation as a downstream lever (TX-004)

context.disease_id: WWOX-deficient human cerebral organoid model (engineered knockout; NOT a patient allele)

p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: No measurement exists in a WWOX system.

cellular_context.limits: The direction is contested: a GSK3 inhibitor pushes Wnt the wrong way if WWOX loss hyper-activates it (DL-MOL-003); 'lower MYC/Wnt is better' is not a safe default.

abstention_card.missing_datum: A dose-by-timing series of Wnt/GSK3/CK1 modulation in a developing cortex with progenitor, layer-neuron and electrographic endpoints, in any WWOX system; and a measured activation step (reporter or nuclear/cytosolic beta-catenin). Never administered in any WWOX system as a Wnt-lowering or tankyrase-type agent, and never as a dose-by-timing series. Two partial exceptions are in the repository: the CK1-alpha-inhibiting multikinase compound of the D01 card was given to knockout organoids (attribution among Wnt, MYC and CDK ambiguous), and a GSK3 inhibitor was given acutely to Wwox-null mice before a convulsant challenge with a seizure endpoint and a measured GSK3 phospho-state in brain (PMID 32000863, repository reading, text re-inspected); neither measures the activation step by reporter or beta-catenin. The transcript direction in organoids is the only Wnt-output measurement.
abstention_card.search_record: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA as a test (known-roads § 2.4c, 2026-10-20); R3 adjacent query on tankyrase inhibition with neuro and development returned 2 records, one read.
adjacent_context_not_wwox_evidence: an esterified tankyrase-inhibitor prodrug in a Shank3b mouse separated toxicity from benefit by formulation, not by dose, from one dose pair (liver and gut toxicity in juveniles)
a GSK3 inhibitor in adult kainate epilepsy: Wnt activation reduced two of four histological markers in one model (opposite direction, different disease)

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card; the sources are the repository's own receipted notes and records.
